description: Pub. 537 (2025), Example 2 continued: the 2026 and 2027 payments aren't taxed (already treated as received) and in the final year 'Total payments ... $500,000 Minus ... − 400,000 Payment on which gain is recognized ... $100,000 × 0.50 Installment sale income ... $50,000'. Line 21 is the $100,000 final payment, line 23 the $400,000 already taxed (line 21 instructions: an amount taxed on line 34 earlier goes on line 23). No second disposition this year.
